_doc: Husks (player facing; mannies in code; Steve, 2026-10-25, renamed 2026-10-26 by the story): empty Vessels the player builds, one per world, in its likeness, driven from anywhere (src/entities/Manny.ts, src/scenes/VaultScene.ts, src/scenes/planet/Link.ts). They are kept in the husk vault: a bunker in the town square at dock px from the base center over a small room below. Stand in its doorway for doorDwellMs (or press action there) to go down; its menu lists every husk you own, builds this world's from cost (iron and hydrogen from this world's store, items.json) and links you into any of them. Built, a husk is kept on the player's row (replicants.traits.mannies, by 'star:planet'); one you leave stands where you left it, else it waits in its pod. buildMs: the assembly in the pod. A link puts you in that husk at once; your own body waits aboard the ship where you left it (traits.ship), and the ship's berth stands empty on worlds it is not on.
